props.name: status
props.meaning: The resolved `Status` row. A plain `list` field has none, so it draws no icon.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the stock sprite is served from, for icons the package does not bundle.

props.name: fallback
props.meaning: Draw the dot for a status that names no icon, so every row carries a leading mark.

props.name: on_color
props.meaning: The glyph sits on the status colour, which is its own ground in both schemes, so the sprite is left as it is.
